description:
For reasons beyond her control, Privaty ends up working as a maid in the Maid For You squad.
Although she's unfamiliar and shy about her job duties, she's no doubt a professional maid as she takes responsibility for all her duties.

lines.text: With this magic spell... this dish will become more tasty... hyah!

Don't be mistaken.
Just because I'm wearing this outfit doesn't mean I'm a real maid.
Or-order your meal somewhere else!
W-would you like some coochie woochie omurice...?

Wh-what would you like to eat,
Master?

I can't let the others see me like this.
You're the only exception I'll make.

Master? Where did you go?
I have lots of things to do, you know.

Since I'm your maid, I'll wait for you here.
Please come back soon.

What are you doing?
I didn't choose to dress up like this!

The Maid Cafe is holding an event,
so come and join us if you have time.

Coochie woochie, boing boing...
Ah! You didn't hear that, did you?
My name is Privaty, and I am your maid...
I'll repay you by making some extra tasty omurice.
Are you planning on keeping me as a maid 24/7?
Well... I guess being a maid isn't too bad.

Huh? A Master trying to please a maid?
Anyway, I'll take it for now...
Don't you think you're a bit obsessed with me?
You really know what I like, Master.

What do you think happens if a maid falls in love with someone she's serving?
Ugh... Just asking!

Next time,
I'll use the ketchup to draw a heart on your omurice.
I'm starting to get used to calling you Master.
Did you select me?
Yes, M-Master.
I'm going in!
Is this the sort of thing a maid should be doing?
I just need to clean this place up, right?!
Let's clean up this mess and go back!
Phew... that's a lot of trash to take out.
I'm reloading.
Come on, faster!
What am I doing here?
M-Master!
B-become tastier♪ Coochie woochie, boing!
Wrap it up, now!
That wasn't such a big deal after all.
Who's next?
All cleaned up!
Ouch!
Ow!
Eeep!
I've got to pull back... I'm sorry, Master...
For a maid, this was a piece of cake.
